page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-64-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 248.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. This balanced allocation of compute and memory resources positions the instance for workloads requiring consistent, dedicated CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core configurations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and moderate memory-to-core ratio provide a predictable performance profile for medium-to-large scale deployments. The absence of integrated GPU hardware and local storage options in this configuration simplifies the resource footprint, making it a practical choice for pure compute tasks where external block storage is utilized.

This server type is appropriate for workloads such as high-throughput web serving, distributed data processing, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and database hosting. The 64 dedicated vCPUs ensure parallel processing capabilities for multi-threaded applications and enterprise-level backend services.
